method: Three alternating pairs of complete 24-workload runs, before/after, after/before, before/after; CPU 2, unchanged inputs/settings. Release artifacts retained by SHA-256. No profiler/build/test concurrent with timings. Allocation counters include the whole driver process with one selected operation. Follow-up: three alternating pairs on custom-converter and references-512 to investigate higher token timings; CPU 2, warmup 4, nine samples of ten calls, identical binaries and observations, no concurrent build/test/profiler.
